# v1.1.4 — Conformance nightly deferred-WG fix

## Highlights

- **Nightly:** Soft-skip deferred WG cases under `cargo test -- --ignored` so incompleteness is not treated as a regression
- **Tests:** Consistent-but-all-unsat honesty asserts; Keys-002 sample for guard/full agreement
- **Catalog:** `deferred_wg_ids.txt` honored by activate-from-disk (drift check)

Drop-in patch over **v1.1.3** — bump all `ontologos-*` pins together. No breaking Rust/Python API changes.

## Install

**Rust:**

```toml
ontologos-core = "1.1.4"
ontologos-parser = "1.1.4"
ontologos-facade = "1.1.4"
```

**Python:**

```bash
pip install ontologos==1.1.4
```

**CLI:**

```bash
cargo install --git https://github.com/eddiethedean/ontologos --tag v1.1.4 ontologos-cli
```

## Migration

- From **v1.1.0**–**v1.1.3:** bump pins to `"1.1.4"` (no API changes).
- From **v1.0.x:** see [v1.0.x → v1.1.0](../../docs/migration/v1.0.x-to-v1.1.0.md) first, then pin **1.1.4**.

Full details: [CHANGELOG.md](../../CHANGELOG.md).
